760	He called the army chief and asked him to stage an attack on the king's palace.	Ele chamou o chefe do exército e pediu que encenasse um ataque ao palácio do rei.
761	Yes.	Sim.
762	And so the army chief did; he organized the whole army.	E assim fez o chefe do exército: organizou todo o exército.
763	And one day there was an assault on the king's palace from every direction, with every weapon.	E um dia houve um ataque ao palácio do rei de todos os lados, com todas as armas.
764	The palace residents tried to defend the king's palace, led by that lowly servant,	Os moradores do palácio tentaram defender o palácio do rei, liderados por aquele servo humilde,

766	for the king, and shielded the king with his own body.	pelo rei, e protegeu o rei com o próprio corpo.

768	their costumes.	as suas roupas.
769	And there was great laughter in the king's palace.	E houve uma grande risada no palácio do rei.

772	But between us...	Mas, entre nós...
773	And the commander of the attackers was actually Yehuda Levi.	E o comandante dos atacantes era, na verdade, Yehuda Levi.
